BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+SUPPLEMENTAL SUPPORT SERVICES FOR INMATES AND JUSTICE-IMPACTED INDIVIDUALS; REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS; GRANT. +]

[+(c) By December 1, 2025, the commissioner shall award a $500,000 grant to the applicant that is best qualified to provide the programming described in paragraph (a). +]

[+$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of corrections for the purpose of section 1. This amount is added to the base. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to corrections; directing the commissioner of corrections to issue a grant to a qualified nongovernmental organization to provide inmates and justice-impacted individuals with virtue-based education grounded in core correctional practices, mentoring, support services, and employment services; appropriating money.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. SUPPLEMENTAL SUPPORT SERVICES FOR INMATES AND JUSTICE-IMPACTED INDIVIDUALS; REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS; GRANT.

(a) By September 1, 2025, the commissioner of corrections must issue a request for proposals to identify a nongovernmental organization to provide inmates and justice-impacted individuals with virtue-based education grounded in core correctional practices, mentoring, support services, and employment services.

(b) An interested organization must submit an application to the commissioner on a form prescribed by the commissioner.

(c) By December 1, 2025, the commissioner shall award a $500,000 grant to the applicant that is best qualified to provide the programming described in paragraph (a).

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATIONS; SUPPLEMENTAL SUPPORT SERVICES FOR INMATES AND JUSTICE-IMPACTED INDIVIDUALS.

$500,000 in fiscal year 2026 and $500,000 in fiscal year 2027 are appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of corrections for the purpose of section 1. This amount is added to the base.
